notes: YES on HB556 third reading (House 103-32, 2023-03-04), enacted as Chapter 254 of 2023: a regulatory and licensing system for adult-use cannabis with a 9 percent sales and use tax. Chair 4 is legalize recreational cannabis and regulate it through a licensed, taxed commercial market - the same instrument set; chair 5 is excluded by the licensing and tax regime and chair 3 because the act legalises commercial sale. CROSS-CHAMBER: Dalya Attar cast this vote as a DELEGATE and now sits in the SENATE (House of Delegates 2019-2025; Senate since 2025-01-24), so the chamber-strict match that seated the other 113 excluded them. Identity verified individually against the mgaleg tenure record, not inferred from the surname; Maryland prints initials only on collision and the roll call rendered this name plain, so the delegate was unique in the 2023 House. NOTE the limit: Maryland voters legalised possession by referendum in November 2022, so this vote chose the market STRUCTURE, which is what separates chair 4 from chairs 3 and 5.
